traits.name: Iron Blood
traits.description: Your lineage survived centuries of mountain frostbite and dragon skirmishes.
traits.perks: +5 Maximum Health, +2 bonus on Survival checks.

traits.name: Hawk of the Crags
traits.description: Uncanny sight capable of picking out ambushes through howling blizzards.
traits.perks: +2 bonus on Perception and Tracking checks.

traits.name: Hearth Skald
traits.description: A commanding yet warm presence that wins over suspicious tavern keepers and jarls.
traits.perks: +2 bonus on Persuasion and Deception checks.

traits.name: Dauntless Hearth-Soul
traits.description: Never trembles before draugr wights or towering frost beasts.
